rv.q: It’s a wonderful showcase for one of this country’s great songwriting teams, even if it’s a mediocre work of theater.
Regardless, for now, it's all 'About Time' that reigns as a very enjoyable evening of entertainment that is smart, sassy and sentimental.
About Time offers a too-rare opportunity to see seasoned musical theater performers do what they do best.
The joyful news is, they haven’t lost their touch, not a whit.
Just sit back and appreciate songs filled with nostalgia, sentiment, humor, wisdom, longing, and regret.

cn.t: Maltby and Shire's songwriting prowess remains sharp in this long-awaited trilogy closer about aging, delivering clever lyrics and catchy tunes that resonate, even if the show occasionally runs a bit long-winded.
